name: galeria-prismas-monorepo
description: Monorepo Galería Prismas: Frontend (React + Vite), Backend (Express + Prisma + SQLite) y API Virtual (json-server)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix api-virtual install
scripts.dev: npm run setup-db && concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,API-VIRTUAL" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix api-virtual run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
